AB - The super capacitor is a small-sized, non-polar high-capacitance electric double-layer
capacitor. It works by storing electric charges in an electric double-layer sunface: of active car-
bon and electrolyte. The super capacitor occupies only 1/1ODth thc volume of an aluminum
electrolytic capacitor of equivalent value, but offers capacitance up into farad units, enabling it
to be used as a back-up power source in electronic appliances or as the current source fór ac-
tuators and electromagnetic valves.
TI - IMPROVED SELF-DISCHARGE CHARACTERISTICS OF THE ELECTRIC DOUBLE
LAYER CAPACITOR.
AU - SUZUKI TETSUO; KATSU KEITARO; OKAMOTO KOUICHI
OS - NEC, Tokyo, Jpn
SO - NEC Res Dev n 82 Jul 1986 p 118-123 (NECRAU)
LA - ENGLISH (EN)

AB - Self-discharge characteristics of the Super Capacitor have been improved by using an
ion permeable porous separator of less porocity. The Super Capacitor is an electric double:
layer capacitor (EDLC) which has several pairs of carbon paste electrodes separated by an ion
permeable. separator soaked in a dilute sulfuric acid electrolyte. The self-discharge current of
the EDLC depends greatly on the pore volume of the separator and décreases with decreasing
pore volume. When the required backup current is small, such as 10 mu A or less, tho self-
discharge current cannot be ignored, and this capacitor's backup time capability for unexpected
power shutdowns will be extended compared with former EDLC. As the equivalent series resis
tance increases with. improvement in self-discharge, this capacitor is suitable for backup whicli
requires a relatively small current over a long time. (Authør abstract) 3 refs:
